name: PSSHI_LCFilter
rationale: The PSSHI_Zener design is highly efficient but fails S4 due to large charge packets from the LC flip causing high ripple and slow settling (large C_out needed for ripple, but large C_out slows settling). Replacing the rectifier's direct connection to the storage capacitor with an LC filter (L2 and C1) allows us to suppress the high-frequency ripple from the flipping pulses while keeping C1 small enough for fast startup and settling. This combines the high voltage headroom of the PSSHI with the ripple suppression of a second-order filter, avoiding the voltage drop issues seen in PSSHI_Zener_Filtered's resistive filter.
